svg.title: Three cloud operating models: centralized, shared management and decentralized
svg.desc: Three stacked panels. Centralized: one cloud team owns governance, security and operations for all workloads; the risk is that one team becomes a bottleneck as scale grows. Shared management: a platform team owns the platform landing zone, guardrails and subscription vending; workload teams operate autonomously within the guardrails; it needs clear responsibilities and strong coordination. Decentralized: each team owns its own platform landing zone and its own workloads; the risk is weaker standardization and a higher chance of security gaps. Icons are official Azure icons for Azure Policy and Subscriptions.
svg.text: Each team also runs its own governance
